work.title: Start with the work people should remember.
work.description: Use a large, varied media rhythm instead of forcing every case study into the same card. These placeholders are deliberately easy to replace.

studio.title: A studio site should be a working sample of the studio itself.
studio.copy: Keep the language short. Make the hierarchy obvious. Let a few well-directed interactions carry the character without hiding the content.
